description: This Java class implements a security context wrapper for Spring Security, providing methods to retrieve the authenticated user, check authentication status, validate access rights, and handle password renewal logic within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: SpringSecurityPlatformSecurityContext
classes.description: A service class that wraps Spring Security's SecurityContext to manage and retrieve the current authenticated user, enforce security checks, and handle password expiration logic.

methods.name: authenticatedUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated AppUser, throws exception if not authenticated or if password needs renewal.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if a user is authenticated by attempting to retrieve the authenticated user.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedUserIfPresent
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated AppUser if present, or null if not, with password renewal check.

methods.name: authenticatedUser
methods.description: Overloaded method that retrieves the authenticated user based on a CommandWrapper, with additional password reset check.

methods.name: validateAccessRights
methods.description: Validates if the authenticated user has access rights to a resource based on office hierarchy.

methods.name: officeHierarchy
methods.description: Returns the office hierarchy string of the authenticated user.

methods.name: doesPasswordHasToBeRenewed
methods.description: Determines if the user's password has expired and needs renewal based on configuration and last update date.

methods.name: shouldCheckForPasswordForceReset
methods.description: Checks if a command is exempt from password reset enforcement.
